title: Match Maker
description:
A mod that improves multiplayer convenience and adds automatic matchmaking.
Match multiplayer lobbies based on community name / language / ascension / player count / installed mods, or use quick rehosting and kick/ban features.

Doesn't affect gameplay, so you can freely play with people who don't have it installed.

https://github.com/TalkingHand/sts2-matchmaker
changeNote: Fixed a bug where leaving the community field empty would still match you into community-tagged lobbies. Added a Copy Link button to the rehost screens (Standard/Daily/Custom) in the same spot the invite button uses on fresh lobbies. Added live autocomplete (recent names) to the community field, plus input-focus fixes so typing no longer leaks into an active match search.
